changes: New Status tab: review completed and ready-to-start tasks by section, with clear Not Started, In Progress, Blocked, and Complete controls.
Track schedule health with a responsive On track / Behind sliding switch. Behind work highlights affected dependent tasks, while the project overview keeps overall schedule health clear.
Forecast the earliest project finish using remaining effort as calendar days. Enter delay days for active Behind tasks and see whether the forecast misses any project deadlines.
Add task update bullets directly in Status. Press Enter to save and immediately start the next bullet, without waiting for earlier updates to finish saving.
Status changes automatically save a daily snapshot of every task, its status, schedule health, and notes. Expand a date to compare task and note changes with the previous recorded day.
A refreshed Material-style layout brings crisp icons, red Behind indicators, and wrapping task history without a separate horizontal scrollbar.

New Plan tab: see project work as a Dependency Graph and a compact Dependency Table. Click a task or section, choose Add dependency, then pick what it depends on. Click an arrow to remove a dependency. Scroll the graph to zoom.

New Roadmap tab: forecasts when the remaining work will finish based on effort and dependencies, with a summary of the expected completion date, sized effort, and unsized tasks. View it across the project or by person.
Click a task on the Plan graph or a Roadmap bar to edit the task in place or add a dependency right from the project header.
Switching between Tasks, Plan, and Roadmap now slides smoothly, with consistent spacing below the project header.
View and More now open options below the project toolbar instead of overlay menus. Open controls stay highlighted, and options are easy to dismiss.
Project tools fit a single row without horizontal scrolling, with icons above wrapping labels on smaller screens.
Clearer project actions make it easier to open the project overview, import or export JSON, and complete and archive a project.
The project header now has a rounded, Material-style Invite button.
Leave project now lives at the bottom of the project overview, with a second click required to confirm.
Polished the mobile experience with cleaner spacing, faster tab transitions, and more consistent touch targets across project and task views.
Improved the invite and collaboration flow so contact requests and project sharing are easier to follow and less error-prone.
Refined search and notification cues to make it clearer when updates are waiting and easier to jump back into active conversations.
Fixed a number of small UI and interaction bugs to keep project, task, and chat workflows feeling more reliable overall.
Tasks with active conversations now show a filled chat icon and message count badge right on the task row — no more guessing which tasks have ongoing discussions.
The project Chat button now highlights and shows a message count when there are messages in the project thread.
Expanding a task to edit it now shows a clean, modern inline editor with icon labels, smooth focus states, and a slide-in animation.
You can now invite people to collaborate on a project — the Invite button is colored to match your project so it's easy to spot.
Added an Export button to save a copy of your project data.
Added a new 'Assigned to me' filter so you can quickly find tasks assigned specifically to you.
Swipe left or right to jump between tabs on mobile.
Helpful on-screen tips appear to guide you around drag & drop and navigation — tap 'got it' to dismiss them.
Cleaned up the mobile toolbar so it stays compact and uncluttered on small screens.
Fixed an issue that occasionally prevented deleting older projects.
Invite links now redirect unauthenticated users to log in and return them to the acceptance page automatically.
Existing projects without an icon are automatically assigned a fun random emoji icon.
Icon search in Project Overview now shows results as you type with smart debouncing.
The arrow guide in Contacts is hidden when an active invite link is already visible on screen.
Introduced a new Chat-based AI Assistant to effortlessly generate, organize, and enhance your projects.
Added 'Effort' and 'Priority' fields to tasks to help you better manage your workload.
Global search now instantly finds specific tasks directly within your projects.
You can now customize your projects by adding custom cover images.
Added the ability to log in quickly and securely using your X (Twitter) account.
Complete visual overhaul of the dashboard, project tiles, and task details for a more professional look.
Added a 'What's New' section on the home page so you never miss an update.
Launched the Connections system! You can now invite contacts using easy-to-share links and collaborate seamlessly.
Dramatically improved app speed with instant, flicker-free tab switching and optimistic UI updates.
Added visual confirmations when deleting projects to prevent accidental removals.
Improved task navigation: you can now open and close a task's details simply by clicking its name.
